description.zh:
账号数量。

**取值说明：**
- GrafanaWorkspaceEdition为**standard**，该参数无效。
- GrafanaWorkspaceEdition为**personal_edition**，该参数无效，默认值： 1。
- GrafanaWorkspaceEdition为**experts_edition**， 可选值分别为：10、30、50，默认值： 10。
- GrafanaWorkspaceEdition为**advanced_edition**， 该参数无效， 默认值：100。
description.en:
Account quantity.  

**Value description:**  
- If GrafanaWorkspaceEdition is **standard**, this parameter is invalid.  
- If GrafanaWorkspaceEdition is **personal_edition**, this parameter is invalid. Default Value: 1.  
- If GrafanaWorkspaceEdition is **experts_edition**, valid values are 10, 30, or 50. Default Value: 10.  
- If GrafanaWorkspaceEdition is **advanced_edition**, this parameter is invalid. Default Value: 100.

description.zh:
语言环境（若不填，默认为 zh）：
- zh 
- en
description.en:
The language. Default value: zh. Valid values:

*   zh
*   en

description.zh:
是否自动续费。取值范围：
- true：自动续费。
- false：不自动续费。

默认值：true。
description.en:
Whether auto-renewal is enabled. Valid values:  
- true: Auto-renewal is enabled.  
- false: Auto-renewal is disabled.  

Default Value: true.

description.zh:
用户额外自定义账号数量。

**取值说明：**
- GrafanaWorkspaceEdition为**standard**，该参数无效。
- GrafanaWorkspaceEdition为**personal_edition**，该参数无效。
- GrafanaWorkspaceEdition为**experts_edition**， 该参数无效。
- GrafanaWorkspaceEdition为**advanced_edition**， 取值范围0~2000，且为10的倍数， 默认值：0。
description.en:
Additional custom account quantity for the User.  

**Value description:**  
- If GrafanaWorkspaceEdition is **standard**, this parameter is invalid.  
- If GrafanaWorkspaceEdition is **personal_edition**, this parameter is invalid.  
- If GrafanaWorkspaceEdition is **experts_edition**, this parameter is invalid.  
- If GrafanaWorkspaceEdition is **advanced_edition**, the value range is 0 to 2000 and must be a multiple of 10. Default Value: 0.

description.zh:
实例包年包月的时间，取值：

- PricingCycle为**Month**，表示按月付费，取值范围为**1**~**9**。
- PricingCycle为**Year**，表示按年付费，取值范围为**1**~**3**。

默认值：1。
description.en:
Subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:  

- If PricingCycle is **Month**, indicating monthly billing, the value range is **1** to **9**.  
- If PricingCycle is **Year**, indicating yearly billing, the value range is **1** to **3**.  

Default Value: 1.

description.zh:
版本。

**枚举值：**
- standard：内测版。
- personal_edition：开发者版。
- experts_edition：专家版。
- advanced_edition：高级版。
description.en:
The edition.

**Valid values:**

*   standard: `Beta Edition or Standard Edition`
*   personal_edition: Developer Edition
*   experts_edition: Pro Edition
*   advanced_edition: Advanced Edition
The name of the Grafana workspace.

description.zh: 实例的密码。长度为8至30个字符，必须同时包含大小写英文字母、数字和特殊符号中的三类字符。特殊符号可以是：()`~!@#$%^&*-_+=
description.en: The password of the workspace. The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length. It must include at least three of the following characters types: uppercase letter, lowercase letter, digit, and special character. Special characters include () ' ~ ! @ # $ % ^ & \* - \_ + =.

description.zh: 包年包月的计费周期，取值： Month（默认值）：按月购买。                                 Year：按年购买。
description.en: 包年包月的计费周期，取值： Month（默认值）：按月购买。                                 Year：按年购买。

descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解可观测可视化 Grafana 版产品的收费方式和<props="china">[价格](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/grafana/product-overview/billing-4?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.7453281fkrsWrp)</props><props="intl">[价格](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/grafana/product-overview/billing-4?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.14c2d253B3SDbt)</props>。
> 
> - 创建可观测可视化 Grafana 版实例需要通过实名认证。<props="china">您可以参见[账号实名认证](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/account/user-guide/individual-identities)相关文档完成认证。</props>
> - 普通用户只支持创建开发者版、专家版、高级版 （`会产生费用`）。
> - 内部测试用户只支持创建内测版（`免费`）。
descriptions.en:
Ensure that you fully understand the billing method and <props="china">[pricing](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/grafana/product-overview/billing-4?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.7453281fkrsWrp)</props><props="intl">[pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/grafana/product-overview/billing-4?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.14c2d253B3SDbt)</props> of the Managed Service for Grafana product before using this API.  
>  
> - Identity verification is required to create a Managed Service for Grafana instance. <props="china">You can refer to the [Account Identity Verification](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/account/user-guide/individual-identities) documentation to complete the verification.</props>  
> - Regular users can only create Developer, Expert, or Pro editions (`fees apply`).  
> - Internal testing users can only create the internal testing edition (`free of charge`).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms create-grafana-workspace --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --grafana-workspace-name testgrafana --grafana-workspace-edition experts_edition --description test --grafana-version 10.0.x --password 'Test123456!' --auto-renew false --pricing-cycle Month --duration 6 --account-number 10 --custom-account-number 0 --aliyun-lang zh --resource-group-id rg-acfmxyexli20000 --tags Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
